pead_nordic_pre_report_drift_20d_q5.market: Nordic equities (scoped research universe; not Sweden-only)
pead_nordic_pre_report_drift_20d_q5.event_definition: PEAD_PRE_REPORT_DRIFT_20D_Q5_LONG_FIXED_EXIT_v1: top quintile Q5 of pre_report_return_20d, i.e. price drift in the 20 trading days preceding an earnings report; fixed event-level exits.
pead_nordic_pre_report_drift_20d_q5.evaluation_period: 17 research years; exact start and end calendar dates not specified in cited summary
pead_nordic_pre_report_drift_20d_q5.methodology: Frozen scoped event-level PEAD_06/PEAD_07 Q5 long rule, fixed exits 20 or 40 trading days, net of 10 bps round-trip costs. 425 unique instruments across 17 years in PEAD_06 selection. Not a portfolio backtest.
pead_nordic_pre_report_drift_20d_q5.source: PEAD_04B_PEAD_RESEARCH_STOP_OR_NEW_DATA_DECISION_AND_REPORT_RESEARCH_REPORT.md; https://drive.google.com/file/d/1yEHis_UKA6Z1SPmWjKyfwueFJIc9MsDV/view ; PEAD_06 and PEAD_07 source packet; scope PEAD_SCOPE_EXCLUDE_FINAL_HOLD_CASES_v1
limitations: Scoped universe excludes 7 unresolved historical instrument cases; full strict universe was not cleared.
Event-level evidence, not an investable portfolio strategy or CAGR.
PEAD_08 portfolio feasibility failed capacity constraints: max 10 simultaneous positions accepted 26.1% (20d) and 16.1% (40d) of signals.
No validated execution model, sizing, stops, or regime filters.
Signal is PRE-report drift, not a positive earnings-day reaction; initial reaction signal was weak/unstable.
Exact calendar start/end dates require verification against primary research artifacts.
